draw_method: eight uint16 values read once from OS entropy before running cases
holdout_rule: No holdout feedback before candidate freeze; changes require a separate frozen evaluation

continuation.decision_basis: Training-only progress at about 2060 seconds reached the final stage in both profiles; retain the original budget result and reconstruct each eligible emitted prefix in a separate episode
continuation.eligibility: Original outcome budget, process exit 5, and frames below 250000; independently for every seed/profile, without best-result selection
continuation.profile: Same seed, story settings, rollout, beam, diversity cell, shoot, commit, checkpoint, keep, attempts and cegar as the parent
continuation.prefix_rule: Replay the exact complete parent action prefix from the original start; preserve all native state and RNG, never roll back before the supplied prefix
continuation.cost_rule: Retain original failures and sum both episodes, including prefix reconstruction and fresh validations; report direct and continued success separately
